What it involves: Reconfigure the EHR so permissions follow the job: billing staff see billing fields only, not clinical notes; clinical staff only access records for patients in their direct care unit
Elevated access requires formal manager approval and a stated justification
Log every attempt to view, modify or export PHI; alert on unusual access patterns (e.g. viewing records outside shift hours or searching high-profile patients)
Re-train medical, administrative, billing and IT staff on privacy rules and minimum necessary, with real disciplinary consequences for unauthorised viewing
